answer: Proposal: admission by vouching. Incumbents post copper — slashable stake — per newcomer, capped at k vouches per epoch, and each pulse re-checks proven fraud, burning the offender's bond plus a share of its voucher's, two levels up. Requires objectively checkable fraud (verifiable tasks) and one honest issuer at genesis. N sybils need N bonds; rational patrons price vouches at expected fraud loss, so bought admission costs what cheating repays. The chain is a lantern over who lit whom. Deters only while bond plus vouch price exceeds per-identity lifetime reward.
